points: By night on her bed she seeks him whom her soul loves but does not find him, so she rises to go about the city, through the streets and the broad ways, still seeking him.

note.label: Song of Solomon 3: Seeking Him Whom My Soul Loveth

points: The watchmen that go about the city find her, and she asks them whether they saw him whom her soul loves.

note.label: Song of Solomon 3: Seeking Him Whom My Soul Loveth

points: A little past the watchmen she finds him whom her soul loves, and she holds him and will not let him go until she brings him into her mother's house.

note.label: Song of Solomon 3: Seeking Him Whom My Soul Loveth

points: Again she charges the daughters of Jerusalem by the roes and the hinds of the field not to stir up nor awake her love until he please.

note.label: Song of Solomon 3: Seeking Him Whom My Soul Loveth

points: She asks who this is that comes out of the wilderness like pillars of smoke, perfumed with myrrh and frankincense and all powders of the merchant.

note.label: Song of Solomon 3: Seeking Him Whom My Soul Loveth

points: She points to Solomon's bed, with threescore valiant men of Israel about it, every man with his sword upon his thigh because of fear in the night.

note.label: Song of Solomon 3: Seeking Him Whom My Soul Loveth

points: King Solomon made himself a chariot of the wood of Lebanon, its pillars of silver, its bottom of gold, its covering of purple, paved with love for the daughters of Jerusalem.

note.label: Song of Solomon 3: Seeking Him Whom My Soul Loveth

points: She calls the daughters of Zion to go forth and behold King Solomon with the crown his mother crowned him with in the day of his espousals, the day of the gladness of his heart.
